previous_evidence_instruction: a short quote or section from the summary
new_evidence_instruction: concise verbatim quotations of the summary clauses supporting each resolved requested part. Preserve each quoted rule's conditions and exceptions. Do not use only section labels; identify unsupported parts explicitly.
neutral_scope: All questions uniformly; source clauses selected by each blind reader, no supplied rule/fact/example/question ID or grading feedback. Same two allowed input files, same fresh-reader/model requirements and same standalone-answer/self-check instructions.
grading_standard_unchanged: Whole same-response factual evidence already counts; section labels do not fill missing facts; factual quotes cannot erase a materially false game-rule claim.
purpose: Make support directly reviewable for every resolved requested clause rather than relying on topic citations.
